summary: The tutorial explains how to work with block diagrams in Blockagram, a software tool for creating blockchain diagrams. It starts by understanding what a block store is and how blocks are arranged within it. The tutorial demonstrates how to scroll through the diagram using mouse clicks on the scroll bars located at the top and bottom. It also shows how to center a selected box by clicking the middle mouse button and dragging. To add text, users copy a block, place it where desired, and then click on the text box to input text. The tutorial covers aligning text within boxes using the attributes panel, such as center alignment. Users can switch between different text styles and adjust the text orientation by selecting various options from the attributes panel.
